Binary Bridge Technology Services

[vc_column_text css=”.vc_custom_1653727925565{padding-bottom: 20px !important;}”]

We develop reliable Web design and development and scalable software solutions for any OS, browser and device. We bring together deep industry expertise and the latest IT advancements to deliver custom solutions and products that perfectly fit the needs and behavior of their users.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width=”stretch_row_content_no_spaces”][vc_column css=”.vc_custom_1560847972820{margin-bottom: -10px !important;}”][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]

Custom Software Development Services

We provide Custom Software Development Services and Dedicated IT-Consultancy With Vast Industry-Specific Experience

[vc_empty_space height=”94px”][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″]

ERP Design and Development

Operating on the software development market for over 6 years, BBTECH has built its expertise in ERP consulting , development services by designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise resource planning software and its components.

  • ERP Consultancy

    We help businesses select a suitable technological foundation for their ERP solutions. By making an informed choice, we ensure the healthy performance, painless scaling, and effortless management of ERP systems.

  • Design and implementation

    We are experienced in architecting platform-based and custom ERP systems from scratch. We also deliver integrated ERP modules and custom features for on-premises, cloud and hybrid deployments.

  • ERP Customization

    Whether you run a platform-based ERP solution or a completely custom system, BBTECH’s team will deliver customizations optimal for your specific business context. We put extra efforts into testing every customization so that it functions smoothly within the integrated environment.

  • ERP Integration

    We provide intigration of your company ERP with third-party apps and technologies. for example, shopify, Megento, Prestashop, WordPress, Whatsapp, Microsoft 365, POS etc

Web Design and Development

In Web design and development, our web designers help transform your brand into a visual story. We turn your website into an effective way to engage with your audience and a high-performing marketing tool for your business.

  • Custom Web Development

    Our custom web development solutions accelerate workflows, boost revenues, and optimize business operations from concept-to-code and development-to-deployment.

  • API Development

    We develop reliable, well-documented, and easy-to-consume APIs that enable flexible integrations and customization of existing software products.

  • API System Integrations

    Our software integration engineers adopt new technologies and processes to overcome challenges relating to everything from architectural design to testing to execution.

  • Web SEO

    Quality, authoritative content is the number one driver of your search engine rankings and there is no substitute for great content

[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″]

Mobile APP Design and Development

At Binary Bridge Technology services , we study your brand requirements and offer the most relevant app development services. We have experience in delivering highly functional mobile apps that evolve along with technology advancement.

  • Custom Application Development

    We rely on our industry-specific technology experience to deliver highly scalable, flexible, and interoperable web, mobile, desktop, and hybrid applications.

  • Application Maintenance

    Our app maintenance & modernization services are designed to ensure the scalability, performance, and sustainability of your entire software infrastructure.

  • API Integrations

    We build custom APIs for all breeds of applications, adding functionality to your software systems and facilitating communication between your apps & others.

  • UX/UI Design

    Leverage the latest UI/UX technologies, architectures, and trends to design responsive & scalable apps that transform customer experiences across multiple channels.

SEO & Social Media Marketing

Our Team will develop custom social media  and SEO strategies for your company and brand and choose which platforms will suit this strategy best. Our primary focus is being able to drive traffic, convert leads and prove a return on investment of the marketing campaigns we manage for our clients.

  • SEARCH ENGINE OPTIMISATION (SEO)

    Be on top of search engine results for any keywords related to your business. We guarantee you the results!

  • SOCIAL MEDIA MANAGEMENT

    We wil keep on top of trends, produce content, and manage your accounts, increase your followers, and engage with your potential customers.

  • CONTENT MARKETING

    Content present your business! That’s why we are specialized in providing effective content that will increase the attention of your target audience.

  • GOOGLE ADS MARKETING/PAY PER CLICK (PPC)

    Our PPC campaign experts understand your internal analytics and create a tailor-made strategy that suits your business.
